doc: Per-world legend questions for the SOP-BERT reader. One cutter head splits a message into request spans; then, per request, one head per question below. A question absent from a request's answers means 'none'. *_span answers are exact substrings of the request span (the reader tags those words). Closed answers must be one of the listed values. Open answers are a lowercase English lemma (singular noun or base adjective).

mood.ask: Does the user want it done, suggested, checked, or answered?

ask_kind.ask: For a question (act=answer): what is asked?

target_fill.ask: How is the thing acted on given?

target_span.ask: Words naming the existing target (a name or the description words)

negated.ask: Which question's answer is negated or excluded (e.g. 'no circles' -> shape)?

fragment.ask: Is this a fragment correcting the previous request?

axis.ask: Which axis the relative change is on

drawing.doc: A drawing page with drawn things (any concrete thing that can be pictured: house, tree, duck, sun, child, swing, face/avatar...). Things have kind, place (position or in/on another thing), size, colour, and parts (petals, roof, hair, eyes). Avatars/faces are drawn things with features. Acts: make, place (move), change, remove, arrange, undo, redo, answer.

anchor_span.ask: Words naming the other thing of the relation

part.ask: Which part of the thing (lemma: petal, roof, hair, eye, window...)

feature_value.ask: Value given to the part or feature, besides colour (lemma: curly, round, smiling, open...)

whole.ask: A scene asked as a whole (lemma: landscape, garden, beach, street, farm...)

parts_list_span.ask: Words listing the parts the user names for a whole

diagram.doc: Diagrams made of nodes (label, shape, colour, position, value) and links (from, to, style, arrow). Charts are a kind of diagram whose nodes are bars/points/slices with values. Acts: make, place, change, remove, connect, disconnect, arrange (layout/tidy), undo, redo, answer.

label_span.ask: Words of a node label or new name

from_span.ask: Words naming the source node of a link

to_span.ask: Words naming the goal node of a link

value.ask: A number shown by a node/bar/point (digits)

values_span.ask: Words listing several values or labels for a chart

position.ask: Where relative to an anchor node

data_source_span.ask: Words naming where chart data comes from (e.g. 'meetings per person')

document.doc: Documents (texts) with genre, topic, title, tone, and sections (role, order, length). Writing the words is a function; the reader only reads what is wanted. Acts: make (write), place (reorder), change (rewrite, lengthen, shorten, retone), remove, undo, redo, answer.

recipient_span.ask: Words naming who it is for

section.ask: Which section/part (lemma: greeting, introduction, body, conclusion, signature, chapter, paragraph, apology, explanation, summary, heading, list item...)

order_anchor_span.ask: Words naming the other section of the order relation

text_span.ask: Literal text the user wants inserted or replaced

calendar.doc: A calendar with meetings (title, start, length, room, people) and rooms (seats). People cannot be in two overlapping meetings; nor rooms. Acts: make (schedule), place (move/reschedule), change, remove (cancel), undo, redo, answer.

people_span.ask: Words naming each participant (one span per person; list in order)

day.ask: Which day (today, tomorrow, monday..sunday, next_monday.., a date as YYYY-MM-DD, this_week, next_week, weekend)

time.ask: Start time as HH:MM, or a region: morning, midday, afternoon, evening, end_of_day, first_thing

shift_amount.ask: Amount of a time move in minutes (digits)

scope_span.ask: Words selecting a set of meetings (e.g. 'everything on Friday')

free_search.ask: Does the user want a free slot found?
